recommendations.title: Rewrite homepage title tag and meta description for 'property management company' and 'property manager' queries
recommendations.what: Rewrite the homepage <title> and meta description to lead with 'Bronx Flat-Fee Property Management' and a concrete price anchor (e.g. '$99–$299/month flat fee — no percentage of rent'). Current snippet is being skipped at top-of-page positions.
recommendations.why: 'property management company' ranks 1.1 with 172 impressions and 0 clicks (0.00% CTR); 'property manager' ranks 1.1 with 40 impressions and 0 clicks; 'apartment management company' ranks 1.0 with 48 impressions and 0 clicks. Position 1 with zero clicks almost always means the SERP snippet is unappealing.
recommendations.expectedResult: Homepage CTR on these three queries should move from 0% toward 3–6%, adding roughly 8–15 clicks per 28 days at current impression volume.
recommendations.metric: clicks on homepage from generic 'property management/manager' queries in Search Console

recommendations.title: Rewrite title + meta for the Bronx-targeted ranking page on 'bronx property management' queries
recommendations.what: Rewrite the title and meta description of whichever page ranks for the 'bronx property management companies' cluster to lead with 'Bronx Property Management — Flat $X/month, 24/7 Emergency Response (No Heat, Leaks, Boiler).' Include a differentiator in the first 55 characters.
recommendations.why: 'bronx property management companies' ranks 3.8 with 74 impressions / 1 click (1.35%); 'property management companies bronx' 3.9 / 66 imp / 1 click (1.52%); 'property management companies bronx ny' 3.8 / 45 imp / 0 clicks; 'property management in the bronx' 4.0 / 43 imp / 0 clicks; 'property management in bronx' 1.9 / 41 imp / 0 clicks. Combined ~269 impressions, 2 clicks.
recommendations.expectedResult: CTR on this cluster should rise toward 3–5% at positions 2–4, adding roughly 6–12 clicks per 28 days.
recommendations.metric: aggregate clicks on 'bronx property management' query cluster in Search Console

recommendations.title: Rewrite FAQ page title, meta, and intro around flat-fee pricing questions
recommendations.what: Rewrite the FAQ page title and meta to pose the actual questions Bronx owners search (e.g. 'What does a Bronx property manager cost? Flat fee vs. 5–12% of rent'), and reorder the on-page FAQs so pricing, emergency response, and vendor dispatch answers appear first.
recommendations.why: /faq/ has 112 impressions, 0 clicks at average position 5.1 — it's being served but entirely skipped. External research shows top rankings ignore pricing, which is exactly what FAQ traffic typically wants.
recommendations.expectedResult: Move FAQ CTR from 0% to 2–4%, adding 2–5 clicks per 28 days and a measurable position lift as engagement improves.

recommendations.title: Add internal links from relevant existing posts to the 7 orphaned posts
recommendations.what: For each of the 7 orphaned posts, identify 2–3 topically-adjacent existing posts (e.g. other Bronx vs. Mount Vernon fall-prep posts) and add a contextual body link into them. Focus on linking from higher-impression posts to the orphans.
recommendations.why: 7 of 99 posts have no inbound internal links from other post bodies. Nave only adds outbound links from new posts, leaving older orphans invisible to crawl equity. Site-wide averages are weak (97 GA4 sessions / 30 days, 30.32% scroll depth), so distributing authority matters.
recommendations.expectedResult: Orphaned posts begin receiving impressions in Search Console within 4–6 weeks; small lift (1–3 extra indexed queries per orphan).
recommendations.metric: impressions on the 7 orphaned URLs in Search Console
